name: SimplePractice vs ICANotes
title: SimplePractice vs ICANotes: EHR Comparison for Mental Health 2026
description: Compare SimplePractice and ICANotes for mental health practices. See pricing, documentation features, e-prescribing, and which EHR is best for therapists and psychiatrists.

summary.bottom_line: SimplePractice offers a modern, user-friendly all-in-one platform best for therapists wanting integrated telehealth and scheduling. ICANotes excels in rapid documentation with its unique 75,000+ phrase content engine and offers native e-prescribing with EPCS, making it better for psychiatrists and clinicians who want to minimize documentation time.

sections.heading: SimplePractice vs ICANotes: Overview
sections.content: SimplePractice and ICANotes take fundamentally different approaches to practice management. SimplePractice, founded in 2012, is a modern all-in-one platform with over 250,000 practitioners, emphasizing user experience, integrated telehealth, and mobile apps. ICANotes, founded in 1999 by a practicing psychiatrist, pioneered a unique documentation approach using a 75,000+ phrase content engine that enables clinicians to create comprehensive, audit-ready notes in a fraction of the time. ICANotes is one of the oldest and most established behavioral health EHRs.

sections.heading: Pricing Comparison
sections.content: Pricing structures differ significantly based on role. For non-prescribing therapists, ICANotes starts lower at $35/month (part-time) vs SimplePractice at $49/month. For full-time non-prescribers, ICANotes is $75/month vs SimplePractice Plus at $99/month. For prescribers, ICANotes includes e-prescribing at $138-213/month, while SimplePractice requires a $49/month add-on plus $89 setup on top of the base plan, potentially making ICANotes more economical for psychiatrists.

sections.heading: Documentation Approach
sections.content: The key differentiator is documentation style. ICANotes' 75,000+ phrase content engine lets clinicians build comprehensive notes by selecting pre-written clinical phrases rather than typing from scratch. This produces audit-ready, comprehensive documentation quickly but requires learning the phrase-based workflow. SimplePractice uses traditional templates with optional AI assistance ($35/month) for a more familiar documentation experience. SimplePractice's approach may feel more intuitive for those comfortable with standard note templates.

sections.heading: Platform & Mobile Experience
sections.content: SimplePractice offers a significantly more modern user experience with native mobile apps for iOS and Android, extensive calendar integrations (Google, Apple, Outlook), and integrated telehealth. ICANotes does not have native mobile apps and has a more functional (less polished) interface. For clinicians who prioritize mobile access and modern design, SimplePractice is the clear choice.

sections.heading: Which Should You Choose?
sections.content: Choose based on your documentation style preference and prescriber status:

recommendations.when: You want a modern, user-friendly platform with excellent mobile apps, integrated telehealth, and are comfortable with template-based or AI-assisted documentation
You want to dramatically reduce documentation time using the phrase content engine, need audit-ready comprehensive notes, or are a psychiatrist wanting native e-prescribing included in pricing
You're tired of free-text documentation and want a structured approach that produces thorough clinical notes quickly
You value mobile access, calendar integrations, and a polished user interface over documentation speed

faqs.q: What is ICANotes' phrase content engine?
faqs.a: ICANotes features a unique 75,000+ phrase content engine that allows clinicians to build comprehensive clinical notes by selecting from pre-written phrases rather than typing free-text. This produces thorough, audit-ready documentation in a fraction of the time and ensures clinical completeness.

faqs.q: Which is better for psychiatrists: SimplePractice or ICANotes?
faqs.a: ICANotes may be better for psychiatrists because e-prescribing with EPCS is included in prescriber plans ($138-213/month) rather than being an expensive add-on. SimplePractice requires a $49/month e-prescribe add-on plus $89 setup fee on top of base pricing.

faqs.q: Does ICANotes have a mobile app?
faqs.a: No, ICANotes does not have native mobile apps. SimplePractice has mobile apps for both iOS and Android, making it better for clinicians who need mobile access to their practice management system.

faqs.q: Which produces more comprehensive clinical notes?
faqs.a: ICANotes is specifically designed to produce comprehensive, audit-ready notes through its phrase content engine. SimplePractice produces standard clinical notes that depend more on the clinician's documentation style and template usage.
